# Stand with Nancy
# ✦
Stand with Nancy ✦
For organizations and groups
## Partner with our mission
From national advocacy groups to local champions, our supporters are united by a vision for leadership anchored in service and integrity. We invite organizations to submit an endorsement inquiry to begin the formal partnership process.
Submit endorsement inquiry
For individuals
## Add your voice to the movement
Nancy’s mission is powered by the strength of veterans, families, and community leaders. If you are interested in publicly standing with the campaign, add your name to the list of those standing with Nancy.
Endorse Nancy
Our team reviews all endorsement inquiries to ensure alignment with campaign values and reporting requirements. Thank you for your support.
